messages.message_text: Good morning students. Tomorrow we need to discuss the AI project evaluation criteria.
Sir asked everyone to submit project details and architecture diagram.
When is the project submission deadline, Sir?
Deadline is Friday before 5:00 PM on the portal. No late submissions will be accepted.
Is there a presentation also scheduled for this week?
Presentation will be Saturday at 10 AM in Seminar Hall 2. Bring your PPT on a pendrive.
Should we meet before the presentation to dry run our slides?
Yes! We should meet tomorrow at 2 PM in the AI lab to rehearse.
Sounds great. Everyone upload your PPT before Friday so we can combine them.
Got it. I will finalize the model accuracy graph today.
Team, please ensure your database normalization schemas are updated in the report.
Yes Ma'am, we have added 3NF schemas and ER diagrams for WhatsApp AI Agent.
Project synopsis review meeting scheduled for Thursday at 3:30 PM in Faculty Room 14.
Noted! I will print the hardcopy draft of chapter 1 and 2.
Don't forget to push your code branches to main repository before midnight.
CIRCULAR #402: Diploma final semester examination registration closes on Monday, Oct 5.
Campus Drive: Infosys & TCS campus drive registration open for Diploma CSE batches.
Holiday announcement: College will remain closed next Wednesday on account of Gandhi Jayanti.
Reminder: Docker containerization lab assignment submission due this Sunday at 11:59 PM.
Is everyone able to push Docker images to the registry successfully?
Yes, tag it with your roll number and push to student harbor hub.
Who is up for cricket practice at college ground on Sunday morning at 7 AM?
Count me in! Also hostel mess committee meeting is tomorrow at 8:30 PM.

summaries.summary: Today's discussion in the AI & ML Group focused on the final AI project submission and presentation. Prof. Sharma instructed all students to submit their project details and architecture diagram by Friday before 5:00 PM. A rehearsal meeting is scheduled for tomorrow at 2:00 PM in the AI lab, followed by the official project presentation on Saturday at 10:00 AM in Seminar Hall 2.

The CSE Final Year Project Group reviewed progress on the WhatsApp AI Agent capstone. Dr. Kulkarni requested updated 3NF database normalization schemas. The team scheduled a synopsis review meeting with faculty on Thursday at 3:30 PM in Faculty Room 14, and agreed to push git branches before midnight.
